WITH candidates AS (
      (SELECT DISTINCT ON(user_id) user_id,run_id,$4 AS priority FROM personal_runs WHERE lease_owner IS NOT NULL AND lease_expires<$1 AND state<>$5 ORDER BY user_id,lease_expires,run_id)
      UNION ALL
      (SELECT DISTINCT ON(user_id) user_id,run_id,$6 AS priority FROM personal_runs WHERE state=$7 ORDER BY user_id,created_at,run_id)
    ) SELECT user_id AS "user",run_id AS "runId" FROM candidates ORDER BY (user_id>$2) DESC,user_id,priority LIMIT $3

WITH due AS (SELECT user_id,workspace_id FROM personal_workspace_runtime WHERE sandbox_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT COALESCE((data->>$4)::boolean,$5)
      AND (last_used_at IS NULL OR last_used_at<=$1::bigint-$3::bigint OR (last_used_at<=$1::bigint-$2::bigint AND COALESCE(data->>$6,$7) NOT IN ($8,$9)))
      ORDER BY checked_at,last_used_at NULLS FIRST,user_id,workspace_id LIMIT $10 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED)
      UPDATE personal_workspace_runtime w SET checked_at=$1 FROM due d WHERE w.user_id=d.user_id AND w.workspace_id=d.workspace_id RETURNING w.user_id AS "user",w.data AS workspace
